C0991.title: JX3 Account-Sharing Groups Banned En Masse, Players Use Slang to Evade Detection
C0991.summary: In November 2021, after Tencent filed lawsuits against online account rental platforms and won compensation, it further cracked down on account renting and sharing in QQ groups. A large number of JX3 account-sharing groups were banned due to keyword detection.
